title: Products
intro: Products I’ve built, on my own and through my company, The Auspicious Company.

sections.heading: On my own
sections.intro: These aren’t related to each other: most grew out of my own interests, and one started because someone asked for help.

items.name: MichiKanji
items.line: Look up any Japanese kanji: free stroke order, readings and meanings for all 1,910 JLPT kanji.

items.name: Tan Dash
items.line: A runner game that teaches hiragana, katakana and kanji. Free to start, no ads.

items.name: Llanai
items.line: A journal for writing in Japanese. Each mistake is marked, explained and queued for review.

items.name: KanjiFun
items.line: Learn your first kanji in a pixel-art adventure game.

items.name: Swimming Rhodes
items.line: Website and online shop for a swimming school in Rhodes, Greece. I built it and run it for the owners.

items.name: FieldPi
items.line: Physical Intelligence, a newsletter I write: operator observations from agriculture, construction and robotics.

items.name: Setian
items.line: A personalised calendar for every student, kept current from the school’s timetables and policies, with an assistant families can ask about school life.

items.name: RapidSafeSystems
items.line: AI construction project management for builders in Sydney: SWMS forms, safety compliance and workflows.

items.name: privisay
items.line: Private speech-to-text for Mac. Press a shortcut, speak, and the text appears, transcribed on your Mac with nothing sent to the cloud.

items.name: Mangood
items.line: Scan a grooming product or supplement barcode for a safety score personalised to men’s health.

items.name: Pomenatal
items.line: Scan skincare, makeup, prenatal vitamins and baby products for ingredients to avoid while trying to conceive, pregnant or breastfeeding.

items.name: Outbreak Files
items.line: Current disease outbreaks, with every figure sourced and dated.
